P.name: Death in Lavender
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Bel'Veth''' is allowed to exceed the {{tt|attack speed cap|normally 3.003 attacks per second}}. Her {{as|attack speed}} does not increase through [[Champion statistic#Increasing_Statistics|growth (per level)]].
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' {{tip|ability}} casts grant her {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 3 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts.
P.description3:
{{sbc|Innate:}} Whenever '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against a {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|monster}}, or large {{tip|minion}} within 3 seconds of damaging them, she generates a permanent {{tip|stack}} of ''Lavender''. Large minions and monsters generate 1 stack, champions and epic monsters generate 2 stacks.

{{sbc|Lavender:}} For each stack, '''Bel'Veth''' gains {{as|{{pplevel|0.1; then +0.05*x for 4; then +0.1*x for 5; then +0.15*x|1 to 18|key=%}} '''bonus''' attack speed}}.

Q.name: Void Surge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} in the designated direction, though not through terrain, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies she passes through. Against the first target, ''Void Surge'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Bel'Veth|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
Q.description3: ''Void Surge'' can be cast only within a cardinal direction that is off cooldown, and incurs a cooldown between casts. {{tt|Each cardinal direction|Total of 4 directions}} has a unique {{sti|cooldown}} that is reduced equivalent to {{fd|0.2}} {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}} per {{tt|{{as|1% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Benefits from all sources of bonus attack speed except the temporary bonus from Death in Lavender}}. These cooldowns reset upon [[death|respawning]].
Q.description4: ''Void Surge {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attack timer.''

W.name: Above and Below
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' slams her tail down in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for a duration, and {{tip|slow|slows}} them by 30% for 2 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|80 to 320}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}}}}
{{st|Knock Up Duration|{{ap|0.6 to 1}} seconds}}
W.description2: If this hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, it resets ''{{ais|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' dash {{sti|cooldown}} of the target direction.

E.name: Royal Maelstrom
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' enters a frenzy for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which she is unable to move, but gains damage reduction and {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}.
E.description2: While active, she rapidly slashes at the nearest enemy with the lowest {{as|'''current''' health}} percentage for up to 6 (+ 1 per {{tt|{{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}|Benefits from all sources of bonus attack speed}}) times over the duration. Each slash deals {{as|physical damage}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}, and applies {{tip|on-hit}}, {{tip|on-attack}}, and {{tip|spell effects|spell}} effects, with on-hit and on-attack damage reduced to {{as|{{pp|key=%|key1=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|12 to 24 for 11|0 to 100|formula=0.12% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}} effectiveness. '''Bel'Veth''' cannot perform slashes while she is affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.
E.leveling2: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage per hit|{{ap|10 to 18}} {{as|(+ 12% AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2 to 18*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2}}% AD)}}}}
E.description3: ''Royal Maelstrom'' deals 200% damage to {{tip|monsters}}, {{tip|applies lifesteal|applies}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
E.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2 to 18*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2}}% AD)}}|Maximum Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|10*2*2 to 18*2*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|12*2*2}}% AD)}}}}
E.description4: ''Royal Maelstrom'' can be recast after {{fd|0.75}} seconds within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration or when '''Bel'Veth''' casts an ability.
E.description6: ''The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability.''

R.name: Endless Banquet
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Bel'Veth's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-hit}} apply a mark to the target for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits. Every attack {{tip|on-hit}} against the marked target deals {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} and generates a stack of ''Endless Banquet'' that increases this damage by the same value. This effect stacks infinitely, but is capped at 8 stacks against epic {{tip|monsters}}.
R.leveling:
{{st|Bonus True Damage|{{ap|2 to 6}} {{as|(+ 3% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
{{st|Maximum Monster Damage|{{ap|2*8 to 6*8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|3*8}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
R.description2: {{sbc|Passive:}} When '''Bel'Veth''' scores a {{tip|takedown}} against an enemy {{tip|champion}} or epic {{tip|monster}} while alive, a ''Void Coral'' is spawned from their corpse for 15 seconds. {{ui|Baron Nashor}}, the pit {{ui|Rift Herald}}, and {{ui|Voidgrub|Voidgrubs}} (once per spawn group) spawn an ''Enhanced Void Coral''.
R.description3:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Bel'Veth''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target ''Void Coral'' to consume it over the cast time, {{tip|slow|slowing}} nearby enemies by {{pp|type=seconds elapsed|key=%|25;42;69;96|0 to 0.75|changedisplay=true}} for the duration. She then creates an explosion at the location to deal {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}} to enemies within, capped at {{as|1500|true damage}} versus monsters, and assumes her {{sbc|True Form}} for {{pp|45;90;infinite|0;40;80|type=[[File:Bel'Veth Death in Lavender.png|20px|link=]] ''Lavender'' stacks}} seconds.
'''Bel'Veth''' consumes all existing ''Void Corals'' at once, generating a stack of ''{{ai|Death in Lavender|Bel'Veth|Lavender}}'' for each one consumed.
R.leveling3: {{st|True Damage|{{ap|150 to 250}} {{as|(+ 150% AP)}} {{as|(+ 20% of target's '''missing''' health)}}}}
R.description4:
{{sbc|True Form:}} '''Bel'Veth''' evolves into a monster, gaining {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' health}}}}, {{sti|'''bonus''' attack range}}, increased size, as well as increased {{as|'''total''' attack speed}}. ''{{ai|Void Surge|Bel'Veth}}'' can {{tip|dash}} through [[terrain]]. Consuming a ''Void Coral'' {{tt|refreshes|See notes}} the duration of {{sbc|True Form}} and {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Bel'Veth'''.

{{sbc|Enhanced Void Coral Bonus:}} {{sbc|True Form}} is empowered to causes ''Void Remora'' to spawn from allied and enemy {{tip|minions}} that die nearby.
R.description5: ''A nearby Void Coral is required to cast this ability. The passive {{as|'''bonus''' true damage}} is affected by the {{tip|on-hit}} modifier of {{ai|Royal Maelstrom|Bel'Veth}}. See [[Bel'Veth#Pets|Pets]] for details about Void Remora and Void Corals.''
